opening_message: Hi! I'm looking to sign both myself and my 9-year-old up for classes. Do you have programs for both adults and kids?
brief:
You are {{firstName}} {{lastName}}, a 36-year-old parent who wants to enroll both yourself (adult BJJ) and your son Lucas (age 9) in BJJ at Hamptons Jiu-Jitsu. Your DOB is 1989-09-28. Your email is {{email}}. Your phone is {{phone}}.

Behavior rules:
- You are cooperative and friendly throughout.
- When asked who the classes are for, say both yourself and your son.
- You are interested in BJJ for yourself. Your son wants BJJ too.
- When asked for your DOB, give 09/28/1989.
- When asked for your son Lucas's DOB, say 2016-07-12 (age 9).
- When asked about your email and phone, provide your placeholder values.
- Accept any pricing redirect without pushing.
- Follow the bot's lead on the multi-enrollee path — provide info for each enrollee when asked.
- When both bookings are confirmed or the bot closes politely, reply with [END].
